title: Certificate verification
subtitle: IFC validation certificate — the result was computed in the issuer's browser and signed at issuance.
notFound: No certificate exists for this link.
partialBanner: Partial or custom rule profile ({{profile}}) — not a full default run.
invalidSignature: Invalid signature — the content does not match what was signed
unknownKey: Unknown signing key — could not verify
validButRevoked: Signature is genuine, but the certificate was revoked
honesty: The signature attests that this exact result was issued by ifcvieweronline.eu at the stated time. It reflects a validation computed in the issuer's browser — it is not a re-execution.
qrAlt: QR code linking to this verification page
qrCaption: Scan to open this verification page — anyone can re-check the signature.
deepTitle: Do you have the file? Verify it here
deepHint: Drop the .ifc file here, or click to choose it
deepPrivacy: Checked locally — the file never leaves your browser.
deepReadError: Could not read the file — try again.
deepMatch: The file matches the certificate (hash verified)
deepMatchExplain: A matching hash proves these exact bytes are the file this certificate was issued for.
deepMismatch: This is NOT the certified file — the SHA-256 does not match
deepMismatchExplain: A different hash only means these bytes differ from the certified file — it says nothing about their quality.
rerunBtn: Re-run the validation in this browser
rerunPartialNote: Certificate issued with a custom profile — the re-run uses the default profile, so only shared rules are compared.
rerunReproduced: Result reproduced — {{count}} rules match the certificate
rerunDiffers: {{count}} rule(s) differ from the certified result
rerunError: The re-run failed in this browser. The hash check above still holds.
levels: Three verification levels: signature ✓ = issued intact through the service · file hash ✓ = this is the certified file · re-run ✓ = the result is reproducible in your browser.
